channel.title: Papad Pixels AI News
channel.description: AI image and video generation news, explained for brands.

item.title: ChatGPT Ads now rewrites your ads by default: what brands should check
item.description: OpenAI switched on creative enhancements in ChatGPT Ads on 30 October: AI can rewrite, translate and resize your ads unless you opt out. How to check.

item.title: From 30 October, brands carry the risk when Meta's AI changes their ads
item.description: Meta's new terms make advertisers solely responsible for AI changes to their ads from 30 October, even features Meta turns on. What to check now.

item.title: Meta: 10 million advertisers now use its AI ad tools, and creator ads hit a $15 billion run rate
item.description: Meta says nearly 10 million advertisers used its AI creative tools last quarter and creator ads passed a $15B run rate. What it means for your ads.

item.title: FLUX 3 Max is out: a 10-second AI video in about 12 seconds, at top-tier quality
item.description: fal and Black Forest Labs launched FLUX 3 Max, an AI video model that renders a 10-second clip in about 12 seconds. Speed, price and what it means for brands.

item.title: Kling 4.0 is officially out: 30-second AI video in one go, with more control over every shot
item.description: Kling 4.0 officially launched with 30-second AI video in one generation, 15 references and 10 keyframes. What's live, what's coming, what it means for brands.

item.title: Meta Muse Wonder: what Meta's first frontier AI model means for brands on Instagram and Facebook
item.description: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier AI models. What they do, what they cost, and what they mean for brands on Instagram and Facebook.

item.title: Meta opens AI video ads to all advertisers: still images now become video ads on Facebook and Instagram
item.description: Meta made its image-to-video ad tool available to all advertisers and widened Ads Creative Studio. What changed and what it means for brand video.

item.title: Google opens SynthID Detector to everyone: check if an image, video or audio clip was made with AI
item.description: Google's SynthID Detector is now free for everyone and reads watermarks from Google, OpenAI, NVIDIA and Kakao. What it checks, limits and why brands care.

item.title: Vidu Q4 Preview: ShengShu's new AI video model focuses on acting, voice and 4K
item.description: Vidu Q4 Preview is out: 15 image references, 3 voice references, up to 16-second clips in 4K. Features, pricing and what it means for AI ads.

item.title: NVIDIA backs Reactor, the startup making AI video run in real time
item.description: NVIDIA and Sapphire Ventures join Reactor's Series A, taking the real-time AI video startup to $74M. What Reactor does and what it means for brands.

item.title: OpenAI will show ads while you create images in ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI will test labelled visual ads in ChatGPT image generation in the US from late October 2026: who sees them, how they work, what it means for brands.
